description: The Context count reports generated tokens rather than uncached prompt tokens.
trigger: Enable --show_tps and complete a reply whose generated-token count differs from prompt_tokens minus cached_tokens.
expected_behavior: Display the uncached prompt count alongside the prompt throughput computed from that count.
actual_behavior: new_tokens is overwritten with r['new_tokens'] before formatting both Context and Generate, pairing the generated count with prompt throughput. The script entry point reaches this shared post-stream block in either output mode.

verification.description: For 60 uncached prompt tokens and ten generated tokens, the transcribed output displayed Context: 10 while retaining 60/2 = 30 t/s.
verification.limits: Synthetic metadata; no inference or timing measurement.
